run_mpc_linear_svm_multiprocess: run the MPC linear SVM training example in multiprocess mode with configurable world size and epochs
run_mpc_linear_svm_single_process: run the MPC linear SVM training example as a single process with default parameters
run_mpc_linear_svm_custom_params: run the MPC linear SVM training with custom epochs, examples, features, and learning rate
run_mpc_linear_svm_skip_plaintext: run the MPC linear SVM training and skip plaintext SVM evaluation
run_mpc_linear_svm_aws: run the MPC linear SVM training across AWS EC2 instances using the AWS launcher script
